findings.title: Privacy page on boundview.com is the private workspace policy ("no public sign-up, no advertising, no analytics trackers"); /terms.html returns 404; no consent gate
findings.fix: Write BoundView-specific privacy policy (ad network, cookies, neurons, push, data sale/share, state rights) and Terms; ship before the earn surface; add consent banner with equal-prominence reject; counsel review
findings.psc: PSC-7 + PSC-2 (link crawl + policy-vs-feature checklist in release gate)

findings.title: Balance is hardcoded "1,240"; neurons-claim call sends user_id in the body with no Authorization header; errors are swallowed
findings.fix: Skeleton until authenticated read; derive user from the JWT server-side; ignore body user_id; surface errors with retry and last-updated
findings.psc: PSC-3 (contract test: no body-supplied identity) + PSC-4 (balance component)

findings.title: Wall will be dead on integration: host CSP has no frame-src; iframe sandbox lacks allow-popups-to-escape-sandbox; no load/timeout handling
findings.fix: Add provider frame-src in the HTTP header CSP; add popup-escape flag; add 8 s load timeout with retry and fallback link

findings.title: Cap messaging incomplete: hardcoded 10/day ring, no monthly (60) meter, no cap-reached state; UTC reset surfaces as 4 pm PT; 60 s cooldown unexplained
findings.fix: Read caps from the API; add monthly meter; cap-reached overlay with local reset time; cooldown timer; decide on local-midnight reset (E11 D-05)
findings.psc: PSC-3 (UI caps equal API caps) + PSC-4 (cap meter)

findings.title: Neuron valuation inconsistent by up to 40x: UI says 1 N ≈ $0.004; redemption catalog implies ≈ $0.0008; master doc D5 implies ≈ $0.0001
findings.fix: Owner picks one rate; publish in `pricing.json`; render everywhere from API; delete hardcoded claims; legal review of any dollar equivalence

findings.title: FTC disclosure is small and hedged ("may earn"): 11.5 px, #7a6f64 on #fdf6ee (4.57:1); per-offer disclosure promised in v261 A6 is missing
findings.fix: Shared DISCLOSURE constant, ≥14 px, ink colour, plain "boundview earns a fee when you complete offers", above the wall and per offer, same wording in toast, email, push
findings.psc: PSC-4 (shared component) + PSC-1 (lint: wall renders only with disclosure sibling)

findings.title: Brand separation leaks: boundview.com manifest says "ai.spaincos"; same bundle on both hosts; BoundView title on the private site; brand enforced only by a runtime DOM scrub
findings.fix: Per-host brand config at build time; split manifests/titles/icons; static-file brand grep in the gate; keep the DOM scrub only as a defence-in-depth check

findings.title: SEO surface is zero: no meta description, og:*, canonical, JSON-LD, sitemap (404), robots without Sitemap line; client-rendered 339 KB shell; private AG is crawlable under a "BoundView" title
findings.fix: Static marketing site (home, pricing, compare, docs, changelog) with metadata, JSON-LD, sitemap and canonicals; `noindex` + auth on the private workspace
findings.psc: PSC-2 (SEO lint in gate) + PSC-4 (head component)

findings.title: Only HSTS is set at the HTTP layer; CSP lives in a meta tag (cannot set frame-ancestors; no frame-src); no X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy; HTML is cache-control no-store
findings.fix: Move headers to `vercel.json`; add CSP with report-uri; set sensible HTML caching with revalidation

findings.title: No age/eligibility gate before the earn surface; ad networks require adults
findings.fix: Date-of-birth or attestation gate before the wall; store the attestation; block under-age cohorts

findings.title: Spain Terminal v2 health failures recur (watchdog 55 s on /api/pdi/layers; at least 10 times after PR #342)
findings.fix: Contract-level timeouts, cached last-good layer, stale banner, circuit breaker; synthetic alert with owner

findings.title: DoorGraph gates open: CanonIntel LLC not formed; tenant isolation and restore not proven; pilot limited to Pacifica
findings.fix: Close gates before any external evidence-room invite; isolation test suite; restore drill; nationwide matrix before expanding

findings.title: Email outreach compliance (CAN-SPAM, state laws, unsubscribe, sender identity) must be proven before any send toward the 250,000-contact target
findings.fix: Seed-list inbox test, one-click unsubscribe, suppression list, physical address, domain warm-up plan

findings.title: comptrove.com returns 403 (`x-vercel-mitigated: deny`) to a generic user agent; legitimate crawlers and first visits may be blocked
findings.fix: Allowlist verified bots and a test user agent; WAF false-positive probe; challenge instead of deny

findings.title: minutegig.com returns HTTP 502

findings.title: Checkout and passkey owner steps pending; price display not tied to one config
